Mental.healHint: Natural healing over some time (Core p. 208)
Mental.healingHint: Damage heals first (1d10 per period), then wounds.
Mental.healed: {name} rests {hours} h: {damage} damage and {wounds} wound(s) healed.
Mental.noHealing: Synthmorphs and infomorphs do not heal: they are repaired (Hardware Test).
Mental.medicalHint: Medicine Test within 24 hours of the injury: 1d10 damage and 1 wound healed, once per injury (p. 208)
Mental.helperRatingHint: A rating typed here replaces the chosen character's skill
Mental.stressTestHint: Willpower Stress Test (WIL × 3) against a stressful situation (p. 214)
Mental.sourceHint: What the character hardens against (the situation if empty)
Mental.hardened: Hardened to {source}: no more stress from it, Moxie maximum −1.
Mental.disorientationHint: After a trauma: a failed WIL × 3 Test leaves the character disoriented, spending a Complex Action to regain their wits (p. 209)
Mental.derangementHint: A derangement lasts 1d10 ÷ 2 hours of world time, or until psychiatric help; the GM and the player choose it (p. 210).

severity.moderate: a moderate derangement (or a new minor one)
severity.major: a major derangement (or a new minor one)

Mental.mentalHealingHint: A month without new stress: WIL × 3 Test, 1d10 stress or 1 trauma healed (p. 215)
Mental.mentalHealingText: Heals 1d10 stress, or 1 trauma once the stress is gone.
Mental.disorderHealingHint: Three months without stress or trauma: a WIL Test rids the character of a disorder (p. 215)
Mental.disorderHealed: A disorder is overcome: remove its trait.
Mental.therapyHint: A successful session heals 1 stress per hour, then 1 trauma per 8 hours, then 1 disorder per 40 hours (p. 215).
Mental.therapyText: Session of {hours} h: heals stress, then traumas, then disorders.
Mental.therapyHealed: {stress} stress and {traumas} trauma(s) healed; {disorders} disorder(s) to remove.
Mental.voluntaryHint: The subject agreed to the procedure (the Malleable Mind trait only counts then).
Mental.surgeryHint: Opposed test: Psychosurgery against WIL × 3; the stress applies whatever the outcome (p. 232).

surgeryCondition.nonHuman: Subject is an AI, AGI or uplift (SV +1)

situation.motivationFailure: Failing spectacularly in pursuit of a motivational goal
situation.deathImminent: Awareness that your death is imminent
situation.lovedOneKilled: Being responsible for the death of a loved one

Migration.start: Migrating the world to Eclipse Phase {version}: do not close the world until it is done.
Migration.failed: Migration finished with {count} error(s): see the console (F12).

Pack.supplement-traits: Traits (Transhuman, Sunward, Rimward, Gatecrashing, Panopticon, Firewall)

Setting.initiativeRuleHint: Core Rulebook (p. 188): 1d100 + INIT, with INIT = (INT + REF) × 2. Supplements (Transhuman p. 97, X-Risks): 1d10 + INIT, with INIT = (INT + REF) ÷ 5. The supplements’ bonuses (+1) are worth +10 on the Core scale. Reloads the world.
Setting.halfStressOnSuccess: Stress on a success (X-Risks optional rule)
Setting.halfStressOnSuccessHint: A successful Willpower Stress Test still takes half the stress (round down), as in the optional rule of X-Risks p. 165. Off: the Core rule (no stress).

Background.dropHint: Dropped on a character, the skill ranks (as free ranks), traits (at no cost), aptitude, Moxie and credit bonuses apply; choices are done by hand. Deleting the item does not undo them.
Background.duplicate: {skill} was already raised by another package: exchange or combine the points (Transhuman p. 38).
Background.unknownSkill: {skill}: a skill outside the list, created as a knowledge skill.
Background.unknownTrait: Trait {trait} not found in the compendium: add it by hand.
Background.notReverted: Deleting this item does not undo what it gave.

Advance.title: Spending Rez Points: {name}
Advance.hint: Costs of p. 152. The gamemaster's limits are not enforced: a skill rises at most 5 points a month (1 at 80+), Rep +10 once a month per network, one sleight a month.
Advance.monthly: Training time and monthly limits: Core pp. 152-153.
Advance.boughtSleight: {points} sleight(s), to add from the compendium

error.aptitudeMax: An aptitude cannot be raised above 30 (bonuses aside).
error.skillMax: No skill may be raised over 99.
error.oneSpecialization: This skill already has a specialization: one per skill.
error.specializationMinimum: A specialization needs a skill of 30 or more.

Advance.creationHint: Customization Points the sheet stands for (pp. 134-136): aptitudes above the 105 free points, Moxie above 1, skill points above the linked aptitude except the free ones (skill sheet), Rep above the 50 free points, traits, the active morph, sleights. Free traits from the background or faction: set their cost to 0.

warning.aptitudeMin: Each aptitude needs at least 5 (unless Feeble).
warning.aptitudeMax: No aptitude may be above 30 (unless Exceptional Aptitude).
warning.activeMinimum: At least 400 CP of active skills ({cp} so far).
warning.knowledgeMinimum: At least 300 CP of knowledge skills ({cp} so far).
warning.repCp: At most 35 CP may be spent on Rep.
warning.repMax: No Rep score may start above 80.
warning.positiveTraits: At most 50 CP of positive traits.
warning.negativeTraits: At most 50 CP of negative traits.
warning.negativeMorphTraits: At most 25 CP of negative morph traits.

Ego.resleeveTestsHint: Integration, Alienation and Continuity Tests for the current morph (Core p. 272)
Ego.backupTestHint: LUC Test for a backup from a damaged brain, a farcast or a dead morph (p. 270)
Ego.resleeveHint: Choose the modifiers of the Integration and Alienation Modifiers table (p. 272) and the situation for the Continuity Test.
Ego.notKnowing: Not knowing if or how you died (+2)
Ego.infomorphNoIntegration: An infomorph makes no Integration Test.
Ego.integrationMoxie: An exceptionally good fit: +1 Moxie for this session.
Ego.alienationNone: Adapts well to the new look.
Ego.effectAdded: Penalty added to the actor's effects.
Ego.backupStress: The backup suffers {sv} stress (applied when it is used).
Ego.forkHint: The fork is created as a new actor running as an infomorph (pp. 273-274). Beta and delta forks are pruned with a Psychosurgery Test of the original.
Ego.longTerm: Long-term neural pruning (+30; beta 1 month, delta 1 week)
Ego.fromBackup: Copied from a backup (alpha: Continuity Test)
Ego.deltaSkills: A delta fork keeps at most 5 active and 5 knowledge skills: the best ones are kept, change them as needed.
Ego.pruningPenalties: {n} penalty(ies) for {fork}, chosen by the GM: a skill −20, a 10 CP negative mental trait, 1d10 ÷ 2 stress, extra memory loss (beta), a positive trait lost.
Ego.mergeDone: Merged with {fork}: {memory}, {sv} stress. The fork's actor can now be deleted.
Ego.noOriginal: The original ego of this fork cannot be found.
Ego.burn: Rep burned for a bonus (+1 each, max. +30)
Ego.favorHint: Networking Test: ±10 per level between your Rep level and the favor (p. 287). Rep burned is spent at once.
Ego.favorFound: Found someone (skill {value} for a service); timeframe {timeframe}.
Ego.favorNotRefreshed: The level {level} favor has not refreshed: use a higher level, or burn {burn} Rep.

modifier.familiar: Familiar: this exact morph used extensively
modifier.previous: Previously used this type of morph
modifier.agi: AGI sleeving into a physical body
modifier.uplift: Uplift in a non-uplift (of their type) body

situation.stackPeaceful: Cortical stack: peaceful or not notable death (1d10 ÷ 2)
situation.stackViolent: Cortical stack: sudden or violent death (1d10)
situation.archiveShort: Archived backup: memory gap under 1 day (1d10 ÷ 2)
situation.archiveLong: Archived backup: memory gap over 1 day (1d10)

memory.seamless: a seamless ego, memories of both intact

Aptitude.modHint: Implant, drug or psi bonuses may exceed the morph's maximum (never 40).
Aptitude.cappedHint: Limited by the morph's aptitude maximum (p. 124).

Stat.durHint: Durability: damage the morph can take before incapacitation.
Stat.dbHint: Damage Bonus = SOM ÷ 10 (round down), melee and thrown.

Mods.hint: Permanent modifiers (implants, traits...). Active effects can target system.mods.*
Mods.actionsHint: Modifier to every test (stunned, drugs...). Target of status effects: system.mods.actions.
Mods.defenseHint: Modifier to Fray defense tests (full defense +30). system.mods.defense.

Status.penaltyHint: Wounds and traumas (−10 each), armor layers and effects. Applied to all tests; Initiative only suffers wounds and traumas.

Details.cpHint: Customization Points budget (1,000 if left at 0)

Skill.orderHint: Drag a skill onto another to change the order.
Skill.freeHint: Ranks given by the background, faction or native tongue: they cost no CP
Skill.label: Skill
Skill.keyHint: Used by weapons, morph bonuses and aptitude defaulting.
Skill.ranksHint: Points bought. Total = aptitude + points + morph + other.
Skill.hint: Click a skill to test it (Shift+click: roll directly). * = no defaulting. Italics: defaulting (0 points).

Moxie.flipHint: Spend 1 Moxie point to flip-flop the roll's digits.
Moxie.critHint: Spend 1 Moxie point to upgrade this success to a critical success.
Moxie.ignoreCritHint: Spend 1 Moxie point to treat the critical failure as a regular failure.
Moxie.ignoreModsHint: Spend 1 Moxie point before rolling to ignore all modifiers.
Moxie.alreadySpent: Only 1 point of Moxie may be spent on a single roll.

Attack.hitIf: Hits if the target fails its defense or succeeds with a lower roll.
Attack.noDamage: No damage value set for this weapon.
Attack.title: Attack: {name}
Attack.noTargets: No target selected: target tokens (T) to measure range and defend.
Attack.coneHint: Cone weapon: +1d10 DV at short range or closer, −1d10 at long and extreme range (p. 194).
Attack.concentratedHint: BF/FA on a single target: +1d10 DV (burst) or +1d10 + 10 (full auto), p. 198.
Attack.beamConcentratedHint: Semi-auto beam: give up the second shot for DV × 1.5 (p. 194).
Attack.extraWeaponsHint: +1d10 DV per extra weapon or limb, maximum +3d10 (p. 206).
Attack.extraTargetsHint: −20 per additional target attacked with the same action (p. 202).
Attack.noMunition: {name} is not loaded: reload it with a munition first.
Attack.loadInLauncher: {name} is a munition: load it into a launcher to fire it.
Attack.noAmmo: {name} does not have the {shots} shot(s) this firing mode needs: reload.
Attack.outOfRange: The target is beyond extreme range.
Attack.calledShotMissed: Called shot missed (needs MoS 30+): normal hit.

Combat.hint: Attacks are opposed by the target's Fray (halved against ranged). Click a weapon to attack, then roll damage from the chat card.

Damage.applyHint: Applies to the targets hit by the attack (blasts: every token in range), otherwise to targeted or selected tokens. Shift+click: targeted/selected tokens, even again.
Damage.noTarget: Target or select at least one token.
Damage.noGM: No GM connected to apply damage.
Damage.alreadyApplied: Already applied to: {names} (Shift+click to apply again).

Morph.dropHint: Drag a morph from the compendium. The active morph provides DUR, armor, bonuses and aptitude maximums.

Trait.automatedHint: The system applies this trait’s effect (statistics, skills or the relevant dialog) from its key and level.
Trait.effectHint: Add an active effect (Effects tab) to automate a bonus, e.g. system.mods.woundsIgnored + 1.
Trait.keyHint: Used by the rules: psi (Psi trait level), psiDefense, psiVulnerability. Keep the compendium value.

Weapon.name: Weapon
Weapon.addDBHint: Adds the Damage Bonus (SOM ÷ 10): melee and thrown weapons.
Weapon.launcherHint: Munition sizes this weapon fires (e.g. micro, mini). Leave empty if it is not a launcher.
Weapon.shockHint: A hit calls for a DUR + Energy armor test (p. 204).
Weapon.ratingHint: Rating printed in a creature's stat block; when above 0 it replaces the skill.

Armor.hint: Equipped armor adds to the morph's armor. Each layer after the first gives −20 to all actions (p. 194); accessories are not layers.
Armor.accessoryHint: Helmets, shields...: adds to worn armor without counting as a layer.

Augmentation.hint: Constant bonuses are active effects (aptitudes, armor, Speed, Initiative, wounds ignored, skills via system.skillMods.<skill>). Situational ones (Adrenal Boost) come disabled: switch them on in the Effects tab.

Sleight.strainPerTargetHint: Mindlink: one strain roll, +N per target after the first. Otherwise strain is rolled for each target.
Sleight.damageHint: Damage or stress formula; @wil is WIL (e.g. 1d10 + ceil(@wil / 10)).
Sleight.exsurgentHint: Only exsurgents (and some aliens or xenofauna) have this sleight.
Sleight.hint: Passive sleights are always on. Active ones cause strain when used: 1d10 ÷ 2 (round up) + modifier, for each target (p. 223). Temporary sleights last WIL ÷ 5 turns or minutes; each sustained sleight gives −10 to other tests.

Effect.hint: Target stored fields: system.aptitudes.cog.mod, system.mods.dur, system.mods.init, system.moxie.max...

Macro.ownedOnly: Only items owned by an actor can become macros.

Reload.title: Reload: {name}
Reload.noMunitions: No grenade or seeker munitions in the inventory.
Reload.hint: Unfired munitions go back to the inventory when you switch munition or size.

Opposed.defendHint: Roll the defense (Shift+click: Fray, no dialog)

Harm.shockResisted: resisted: half damage, stunned (−30, −10 per turn)
Harm.shockFailed: incapacitated for {turns} turns, then stunned (−30, −10 per minute)
Harm.fallHint: 1-2 m: 1d10, 3-5 m: 2d10, 6-8 m: 3d10, +1 per meter beyond. Kinetic armor counts for half (p. 197).
Harm.fallHarmless: A fall of less than 1 meter does no damage.

Blast.scattered: Scattered {distance} m, direction {direction} (1 = beyond the target, clockwise)

Psi.levelTooLow: {name} needs the Psi trait at level {level}.
Psi.noTargets: No target: target the tokens to affect (T).
Psi.creatureHint: Animals and aliens are harder to affect and cause more strain (p. 222).
Psi.penetrationHint: Each point of Armor Penetration against Psi Shield costs 1 strain (p. 228).
Psi.affectsIf: Affects each target that fails its WIL x 2 test or rolls lower.
Psi.seizure: {name} suffers a psi seizure: −30 and unable to act until the end of the next Action Turn.
Psi.summary: Psi level {level} · mental armor {armor} · psi defense {defense}

Software.aiHint: Creates an NPC with these aptitudes and skills. AIs cannot default and have no Moxie (p. 264). Weapon and extra Knowledge skills are not created.

Mesh.qualityHint: Mesh gear quality (p. 247): −30 relic, 0 standard, +10 security-grade, +20 next-generation, +30 state-of-the-art.
Mesh.monitorHint: Infosec of the hacker or AI actively monitoring the system; 0 if it is not monitored.
Mesh.cyberbrainHint: Pods and synthmorphs: −30 to hack and subvert; the admin modifier does not apply (p. 261).
Mesh.noExploit: No exploit program: hacking without one is up to the GM (p. 254).

statusHint.hidden: Unnoticed, effectively admin; +30 to subvert the system.
statusHint.covert: Passes as a legitimate user with the privileges sought.
statusHint.spotted: Passive alert: −10 to the intruder's actions; passive countermeasures.
statusHint.locked: Active alert: −20 to the intruder's actions; active countermeasures (lockout, trace...).

Mesh.statusEditHint: The GM updates the status after countermeasures (zeroing in, re-authentication...).
Mesh.retry: Both failed: roll again on the next Action Phase.
Mesh.subvertHint: Status and cyberbrain modifiers apply. Severe Failure: status −1 step; critical failure: Locked. Upgrading needs an Excellent Success.
Mesh.cannotUpgrade: A Locked intruder cannot upgrade their status.
Mesh.crashHint: Crashing needs 2 consecutive wins against an AI, 3 against an AGI or infomorph; it then reboots for 3 Action Turns (p. 260).
Mesh.scorchTarget: Target the token of the ego to scorch.
Mesh.effectHint: Roll WIL x 2 against the scorcher's effect
Mesh.shutterNote: {modifier} to one sense chosen by the hacker, fading by 10 per Action Turn.
Mesh.panic: Panic for {turns} Action Turn(s): flees, breaks down or cowers (GM's choice).
Mesh.hint: Connection preconditions (range, mesh ID, jacking in) are up to the GM. Countermeasures: the GM changes the status.
Mesh.aiHint: AIs cannot default to aptitudes and have no Moxie (p. 264).

Substance.applicationHint: D dermal, Inh inhaled, Inj injected, O oral (p. 317).
Substance.durationHint: Effects last this long once taken: counted down each Action Turn in combat, and in world time.
Substance.takeHint: Take a dose (applies its effects for the duration)
Substance.addicted: {name} is addicted to {substance}: add or raise the Addiction trait (p. 148).
Substance.hint: Constant effects while under the influence are active effects of the item (disabled until taken). Conditional effects are in the description.

Ammo.hint: Reload a kinetic weapon to choose this ammunition: its modifiers apply to the weapon's attacks (p. 337). Railguns only fire regular and armor-piercing rounds.

Vehicle.pilotHint: Pilot skill of the AI or character controlling the shell: used to maneuver, avoid crashes and defend.
Vehicle.crashed: Two wounds at once: the vehicle crashes (p. 196).
Vehicle.deathRatingHint: Death Rating given by the book; empty: DUR x 2.
